<section class="hub-hero">
  <div class="hub-eyebrow">RTM-SUITE &middot; SCOPEINR</div>
  <h1>The full coupled model:<br><span class="accent">reflectance, SIF and photosynthetic capacity.</span></h1>
  <p class="lead">
    SCOPEinR runs the full SCOPE 2.1 forward model in one simulation: leaf optics, canopy
    radiative transfer, energy balance, photosynthesis and chlorophyll fluorescence, coupled
    together rather than run separately. Ported line-for-line to Python
    (<code>scopeinpython</code>) and cross-checked against the R original.
  </p>
  <div class="hub-badges">
    <span class="hub-badge">SCOPE LUT construction</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">Coupled forward model</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">Energy balance &amp; photosynthesis</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">Fluorescence (SIF)</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">Output export</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">R &amp; Python</span>
  </div>
  <div class="hub-actions">
    <a class="hub-btn primary" href="tutorials-r.qmd">Explore R Tutorials</a>
    <a class="hub-btn primary" href="tutorials-python.qmd">Explore Python Tutorials</a>
    <a class="hub-btn ghost" href="../../function-universe-scopeinr.html">Interactive Function Explorer &rarr;</a>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="hub-darkcard">
  <h2>Twelve R tutorials, plus SCOPE's slice of the shared Python path</h2>
  <p>
    The R side is twelve standalone <code>SCOPEinR</code> pkgdown articles (t00&ndash;t11),
    grouped below by theme: getting started and the input structure, energy balance and
    fluorescence, LUTs and parallel runs, then inversion, sensitivity and the real-Sentinel-2
    capstone. The Python side is different &mdash; <code>toolsrtm</code> and
    <code>scopeinpython</code> share one continuous 20-chapter learning path, and SCOPE gets
    one dedicated chapter (06) plus its own package-tagged code examples and real-EO capstone;
    the rest of that shared path (leaf/canopy/soil models, inversion, spatial application) is
    mostly ToolsRTM material, covered on the <a href="../../quarto-hub-toolsrtm/_site/index.html">ToolsRTM hub</a>.
  </p>
</div>
